name: Poly Network
fix_description: In verifyHeaderAndExecuteTx (0xd450e04c), _executeCrossChainTx executes arbitrary target calls as EthCrossChainManager. Add a blacklist to prevent calling EthCrossChainData (or any admin contract): require(target != address(ethCrossChainData)). This prevents cross-chain messages from modifying the keeper.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is more than a trivial missing-access-control bug because the auditor must understand Poly Network’s cross-chain verification flow, craft or replay valid-looking header/proof data, and abuse privileged internal calls to the owner-gated data contract before triggering the asset release. Although the underlying flaw is conceptually straightforward once identified, the PoC involves multi-step cross-chain message execution and protocol-specific serialization/details, putting it above easy but below hard.
